label: iNav-WHU street00 (ADIS16465 IMU 200 Hz, F9P GNSS 1 Hz)
time_base: GNSS seconds of week, shared by all files
imu_frame: x front, y right, z down (static az = -g)
gnss: F9P single point positioning, 1 Hz, no velocity (gps ve/vn/vu are NaN); std_e/std_n/std_u are the receiver's reported sigmas in metres
gt_frame_conversion: NED -> ENU: e=pos_e, n=pos_n, u=-pos_d, ve=vel_e, vn=vel_n, vu=-vel_d
gt_attitude: roll, pitch, yaw not carried into the canonical format
frames: IMU in the sensor/body frame as logged; GPS and GT in ENU
